answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the orchard until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quartz of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The wander of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
